description: i012 (s11, xmit-softirq-lock) complete. FINDING (medium confidence): drivers/net/wireless/marvell/mwl8k.c:1984-1990 — priv->stream_lock is taken with plain spin_lock() (never spin_lock_bh anywhere in the file) in mwl8k_txq_xmit at lines 1987/2051/2074/2124, which is reachable from NET_TX softirq via ndo_start_xmit -> mac80211 drv_tx -> mwl8k_tx (mwl8k.c:4684, calling mwl8k_txq_xmit at 4698); the same lock is taken plainly in process/workqueue context by (a) worker mwl8k_watchdog_ba_events (spin_lock at 3830), queued from the mwl8k_interrupt hardirq BA_WATCHDOG branch at 4613 via ieee80211_queue_work, (b) mwl8k_ampdu_action (5453) from cfg80211/mac80211 process context, and (c) mwl8k_cmd_set_new_stn_del (4160) from sta-removal process context. A worker/user task holding stream_lock on a CPU can be preempted by a NET_TX softirq running mwl8k_txq_xmit, which then spins forever on the lock the holder can never release — soft lockup/RCU stall/TX-stall DoS, the exact seed mechanism (ks7010 tx_dev_lock). Key corroborating evidence: the same function takes priv->tx_lock with spin_lock_bh at 2059/2120, proving the xmit path is expected to run with BH enabled, and the sibling tx_lock is fully disciplined (process sites spin_lock_bh at 1573-1626; plain spin_lock at 4642 only inside tasklet mwl8k_tx_poll). SAFE candidates: ks7010_sdio.c:398 (seed itself, excluded), mwl8k tx_lock (fully disciplined), wil6210 net_queue_lock (plain variant called only from NAPI TX poll softirq at txrx.c:2551/txrx_edma.c:1308; xmit uses the _bh variant). UNRESOLVED: wil6210 txdata->lock (wil_is_tx_idle plain at txrx.c:76 in pm.c:201 suspend path vs wil_tx_ring plain at 2200 from wil_start_xmit; all other sites spin_lock_bh), cw1200 wsm_cmd.lock (plain at wsm.c:1088+; bh is a kernel thread, softirq reachability not concluded), qtnfmac trans.c resp_lock (plain at 30/47/87/136; xmit reachability not traced). LIMITATIONS: 222 plain spin_lock sites in drivers/net/wireless ranked by density, but deep analysis covered only mwl8k, wil6210, ks7010, partial cw1200/qtnfmac; iwlwifi pcie/rx.c (23 sites), pcie/tx.c, and hostap hostap_ap.c/hostap_hw.c (24 combined) were not analyzed; the mwl8k finding is a static hypothesis with no runtime reproducer (tree lacks build config). Artifact: agent-state/findings/i012.json.
